messages:
Elena Moreno: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can leadership give concrete dates/owners for the API / Console / Optimize milestones so teams can lock roadmaps? :wave:

Raj Patel: thanks — short answers first: API feature parity (hosted gen + chat) -> GA target: 2026-07-18 (soft GA). Console UX redesign (beta) -> phased beta starting 2026-06-30. Optimize (cost tooling) -> alpha in mid-Q3, wider preview by end of Q3. will add owners below. :memo:

Marta Gomez: clarifying — is the API GA date dependent on Dedicated capacity rollout, or can hosted proceed independently?

Raj Patel: hosted can proceed independently for feature parity. Dedicated capacity scaling is on a parallel track and may affect enterprise SLA commitments, but GA of the API surface is not gated on Dedicated.

Theo Li: on Optimize alpha — will that include batching suggestions + quantization profiles, or just heuristics first?

Raj Patel: alpha = batching suggestions + basic quantization recs (intel/ampere tested). full quantization profiles + automated schema will be preview.

Priya Nair: owners request — who should engineering/product teams ping for docs, quickstarts, and SDK changes? cc @devex?

Sam Rivera: owners list (tentative):
- API GA owner: Raj Patel (PM) + Marta Gomez (Eng lead)
- Console beta owner: Priya Nair (DevEx / PM) + Theo Li (UX eng)
- Optimize alpha owner: Theo Li (Eng-ML) + Sam Rivera (Infra PM)
I can set a shared doc and weekly 15m sync. :spiral_calendar:

Elena Moreno: can we get a compact rollout checklist (one-pager) per area? small things like docs, migration notes, canary window, alerting hooks. even a terse table helps. :eyes:

Sam Rivera: putting one together now. draft will include: owner, expected date, canary window, rollback signal, docs owner, SDK changes. posting link when ready.

allhands-bot: Recording + slides from today's all-hands: https://meet.corp/recordings/2460001200 (slides in drive) :movie_camera:

Marta Gomez: one more question — Console beta: will it require backend schema changes that break existing admin APIs? we need depth for partner integrations.

Priya Nair: short answer: no breaking changes; beta introduces opt-in routes and flags. full migration plan before GA.

Theo Li: Optimize alpha has a dependency on the runtime telemetry API being stable. ETA for telemetry stabilization?

Marta Gomez: telemetry stab ETA is 2026-06-20 assuming current sprint. if anything slips I'll flag it here.

Raj Patel: high-level commitments:
- API: soft GA 2026-07-18 (non-breaking, backward compatible); canary starts 2026-07-01
- Console beta: 2026-06-30 (opt-in), public rollout phased starting 2026-08-01
- Optimize alpha: mid-Q3 (target 2026-08-15) with telemetry prereq
These are targets, subject to the weekly readiness checks.

Elena Moreno: thanks — please make the one-pager and add an explicit migration doc link for partners. also add a short TODO for product marketing to draft release notes.

Sam Rivera: created checklist draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/roadmap-checklists/2460001234 (edit access granted to listed owners). short excerpt: 
```
Area | Owner | Target | Canary | Rollback signal | Docs owner
API   | Raj/Marta | 2026-07-18 | 2026-07-01-07:00UTC | token errors up >3% | Priya
Console | Priya/Theo | 2026-06-30 (beta) | opt-in canary | UI regressions >2% | Priya
Optimize | Theo/Sam | 2026-08-15 (alpha) | telemetry smoke | cost reg >10% | Theo
```

Marta Gomez: added a note about Dedicated capacity: separate runbook will live in devops repo, link on the checklist.

Priya Nair: will own release note drafts + quickstarts. tagging design for screenshots. timeline: draft by 2026-06-20.

Elena Moreno: perfect. any blockers that would change those dates significantly?

Theo Li: current risk: telemetry stabilization if we find a major sampling bug — contingency is +3 weeks. will surface ASAP.

Raj Patel: dependencies tracker updated. if any team sees >2 week slip, ping me and Marta so we can re-evaluate launch windows.

Sam Rivera: action items I assigned:
- Priya: draft release notes + quickstarts by 2026-06-20
- Marta: telemetry stabilization updates weekly until 2026-06-20
- Theo: Optimize alpha readiness checklist by 2026-07-10
- Raj: finalize API canary plan by 2026-06-25
I'll follow up with calendar invites. :rocket:

Elena Moreno: thanks everyone. putting this thread in the all-hands follow-up doc. will ping again next week for any drift. :thumbsup:
